metadata.title: The Mississippi
metadata.creator: Greene, F. V. (Francis Vinton), 1850-1921
subject: Vicksburg (Miss.)
genealogy
description: The first year's operations -- Iuka and Corinth -- The first move against Vicksburg -- Bayou expeditions -- The campaign in rear of Vicksburg -- The siege and surrender of Vicksburg -- Port Hudson -- Concluding operations -- Appendix A: Summary of principal events -- Appendix B: Returns of Halleck's Army at Corinth, May 31, 1862 -- Appendix C: Returns of Confederate Army at Corinth, Mat 28, 1862 -- Appendix D: Correspondence with reference to the dispersion of Halleck's Army after the capture of Corinth -- Appendix E: Organization of the Army of the Tennessee, April 30, 1863 -- Appendix F: Organization of troops in the Department of Mississippi and East Louisiana, April 30, 1863 -- Appendix G: Correspondence between General Grant and General Banks relative to the co-operation of their armies -- Appendix H: Union losses in the Vicksburg Campaign
Lincoln copy: [4] p. of the publisher's advertisements at end
